note: Season data for /holidays/theme-park-christmas-events-with-kids.html (QUEUE G16 step 3). Every fact read on the operator's own page on the date shown; research table docs/research/holiday-parks-2026-11-03.md. Update each season; a park leaves the page after end_on. ticket_each is what one person pays, one day; the family figure is ticket_each x 4.
not_listed: Disney, Universal and Knott's Berry Farm

parks.name: Busch Gardens Williamsburg
parks.price_note: $31.99 each, ages 3 and up, for your chosen date. Parking and tax extra.
kids: Tell Santa a wish at Santa's Workshop
parks.extra: Santa's Fireside Feast costs extra and needs a reservation.
parks.watch: A separate event ticket, unlike the other parks here. Members get in with most memberships.
parks.source_label: Busch Gardens Williamsburg Christmas Town pages

parks.name: SeaWorld San Diego
parks.price_note: From $51.99 each, the lowest date price we saw. Your date can cost more. Tax, fees and parking extra.
kids: Meet Santa and two of his reindeer
parks.extra: The snowflake scavenger-hunt map costs extra.
parks.watch: Fireworks on Dec 12 and Dec 31 only. The page prints the end year as 2026; we read it as Jan 3, 2027.
parks.source_label: SeaWorld San Diego Christmas Celebration page

parks.name: SeaWorld San Antonio
parks.price_note: $53.99 each for a chosen date when we read it. Other dates may cost more. Tax, fees and parking extra.
kids: Photos with a cowboy-hat Texas Santa
Walk through the Tunnel of Lights
O Wondrous Night show with puppets and live animals
parks.extra: Dinner with Santa and Mrs. Claus costs extra.
parks.watch: The event starts at 1 p.m. on select days, and the lights run on select nights only.
parks.source_label: SeaWorld San Antonio Christmas Celebration page

parks.name: Hersheypark
parks.price_note: Family 4-Pack, $57 a person, with free parking for one car. Tax and fees extra.
kids: Santa and his 9 reindeer at the airfield
TREEville candy-themed tree walk with treat stops
parks.extra: Breakfast with Santa costs extra (select dates, Nov 27 to Dec 24).
parks.watch: Cold, wind and snow can close rides. If most major rides close for over 60 minutes, you can ask for a free return voucher.

parks.name: SeaWorld Orlando
parks.price_note: $59.99 each, the lowest online day price we saw. Your date can cost more. Tax and parking extra.
kids: Fireworks at park close, nightly until Jan 1
parks.extra: Dinner with Santa costs extra (select nights).
parks.watch: No reservation needed. Many shows are indoors, rain or shine.

parks.name: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
parks.price_note: From $61.99 each online, for chosen dates. Kids 2 and under need no ticket. Tax, fees and parking (from $34) extra.
parks.extra: Rudolph meet-and-greets are tied to a paid Priority Access upgrade.
parks.watch: Tree lighting Nov 13 at 7 p.m. New Year's Eve fireworks Dec 31.
parks.source_label: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay Christmas Town page
parks.price_source_label: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay tickets page

parks.name: LEGOLAND California
parks.price_note: From $69 each online. The gate price is $139. Parking and tax extra.
kids: Feed LEGO reindeer at Reindeer Refuel
Dance around the giant LEGO tree
parks.extra: Early ride access and the holiday dance party are for hotel guests.
parks.watch: Fireworks on Dec 5, Dec 12 and Dec 19-31 only. The dates carry no year; we read them as this season.

parks.name: LEGOLAND Florida
parks.price_note: From $69 each online. The gate price is $129. Parking and tax extra.
kids: Feed reindeer, and mail a letter to the North Pole
parks.extra: LEGO Santa's Workshop ornament building is for hotel guests.
parks.watch: The drone show runs Dec 5, Dec 12 and Dec 19-30 only. Before Dec 18 the event is weekends plus Thanksgiving Friday.
